title: Founder of Prominent Underground Church Released from Prison in China
detail: The founder of a prominent underground Christian church in China was released from prison, highlighting continued tensions between state-sanctioned religious institutions and unregistered 'house churches'. China's religious policy requires all congregations to register with the state-approved Three-Self Patriotic Movement; unregistered churches operate in a legal gray zone and face periodic crackdowns under Xi Jinping's tightened religious regulations.
